summary: Lead your hilarious zombie horde! Build an empire, merge zombies, and dominate!
description:
Stolen. Awakened. Your Empire Awaits. Unleash Zé's Hilarious Revenge!

Welcome to My Zombie World: Merge Empire, the ultimate test of undead ambition and comical chaos. You awaken as Zé, a zombie with a serious problem: humans stole your ancient esoteric treasures! Your only mission: get them back, infect everyone, and build the funniest zombie empire the world has ever seen. And don't worry, Zé will be right here to guide you through it all, with a few jokes along the way!

Bite through dense cities, shatter human defenses, and scavenge brains for your legendary Zervalife Brain Shakes. Every chomp of your zombie teeth brings you closer to merging stronger units and uncovering the hilarious conspiracy behind your undead awakening.

Face the absurdity of humanity. Experience dynamic battles where silly humans try to fight back, demanding evolved zombie hybrids and cunning (and often ridiculous) tactics. Will your Ponzi scheme of Brain Shakes survive the human resistance?

Upgrade your zombie horde from basic shamblers to powerful, merged undead. Meet and rescue other eccentric zombies, build alliances to expand your scheme while piece together the mystery of your past life and the hidden aliens who might help build your glorious statues.

My Zombie World: Merge Empire was Selected for the Big Festival: Panorama Brasil 2023, Google Play Indie Games Fund 2023 and Indie Games Accelerator 2024! Join thousands of players already building their most chaotic zombie empires.

Download now and embark on a side-splitting journey to reclaim your treasures, build your hilarious empire, and dominate the world!
